name: goodreads-mcp-monorepo
description: Read your Goodreads library from MCP clients without sharing your Goodreads password.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.release: pnpm check && pnpm build && node scripts/publish-packages.mjs
scripts.release:verify: pnpm check && pnpm build && RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 node scripts/publish-packages.mjs
